item.title: Watch Steve Zahn, Audrey Zahn, Sonequa Martin-Green and Ethan Hawke in the She Dances trailer
item.description: SHE DANCES is a deeply personal father–daughter story about reconnection, grief, and healing through dance, co-written by Rick Gomez and Steve Zahn. It stars Steve Zahn and his daughter, Audrey Zahn (Imperfect Woman), and Mackenzie Ziegler (Dance Moms), marking feature film debuts for both Audrey and Mackenzie. item.description: Hot off the record-setting resurrection of EVIL DEAD RISE, writer/director Lee Cronin turns to one of the most iconic horror stories of all time with an audacious and twisted retelling: LEE CRONIN’S THE MUMMY. item.description: Mantic Games has announced The Ghost in the Shell: Tabletop Roleplaying Game, based on the pioneering cyberpunk manga by legendary artist Shirow Masamune, published by Kodansha Ltd.
